name: RA-Nested-MCP
description: A two-layer nested MCP server that acts as a telecom Revenue Assurance knowledge agent. It uses an orchestrator LLM (Llama 3.3 70B via Groq) to decompose questions, retrieve from a local vector store of RA documents, and synthesize answers, all running on free tiers.

name: MongoDB MCP Server
description: A Model Context Protocol server for interacting with MongoDB Databases and MongoDB Atlas. It enables AI assistants to query, manage, and operate on MongoDB data and Atlas resources through natural language.

name: Sumi-Docs-MCP
description: Read-only MCP server for Markdown, MDX, and OpenAPI docs, exposing list, search, fetch, and OpenAPI spec tools over stdio.

name: agy-plugins
description: MCP server for managing AI skills and tools from GitHub marketplaces, enabling discovery, installation, removal, and auto-updates via natural language or commands.

name: autochrome
description: MCP server enabling AI agents to perform autonomous photographic color science and screenshot annotation with deterministic computer vision, film emulation, and real-time live preview.

name: touchdesigner-mcp
description: Lets Codex inspect, build, wire, tune, sample, and visually verify running TouchDesigner projects for generative visuals, audio-reactive systems, and fast agent-assisted prototyping.

name: project-analysis-mcp
description: MCP server for persistent project knowledge management, enabling AI assistants to store, search, and reuse project analysis insights with freshness checking and impact analysis.

name: sdcvalidator
description: MCP server for validating SDC4 XML instances against XSD schemas, with two-tier error classification and SDC4 compliance checks.

name: sdcgovernance
description: MCP server for SDC governance validation, exposing tools that agents call to validate governance content in XML instances against SDC data models and return XACML decisions (PERMIT, DENY, INDETERMINATE).

name: realagent-mcp
description: An MCP server that enables AI agents to perform SM2-based identity binding, generate and verify SD-JWT verifiable presentations, and use SM2 cryptographic operations with local communication and national cryptography encryption.

name: factreason
description: Provides dependency upgrade advisories, API schemas for 1,097 services, and electronic component specifications over MCP, with Ed25519-signed evidence.

name: Vulcanus
description: Vulcanus turns a Git-versioned Markdown vault into structured project memory for coding agents. recall returns a project's capsule plus the read-next list, and warns when the capsule is older than the decisions beneath it. search ranks by layer, so the cheapest sufficient note surfaces first. Writes are scoped: update…

name: mcp-html2pdfconverter
description: An MCP server for HTML2PDF Converter. Allows AI agents to seamlessly convert raw HTML strings or live web URLs into high-fidelity PDF documents and save them locally.

name: jc-mcp
description: Token-efficient MCP server for Jira and Confluence that returns lean, flat responses to minimize token usage. Enables issue/comment/transition management, JQL/CQL search, and Confluence page operations.

name: pocket-id-mcp
description: Enables bounded administration of Pocket ID, focusing on OIDC client management and read-only identity inventory, with secure handling of API keys and client secrets.

name: OpenAPI Docs MCP
description: A vendor-neutral MCP server that lets coding agents search and understand OpenAPI/Swagger documents via stdio tools, without calling real backend APIs.

name: search-reader-mcp
description: MCP server extending Jina Reader to provide web page/PDF to Markdown reading and Bocha AI/web search via a single HTTP endpoint, exposing read, search, and MCP tools.

name: keqing-kb
description: MCP server for querying the Keqing customer service knowledge base, enabling AI agents to search structured knowledge entries and retrieve authoritative, citable answers.

name: opensolr-mcp
description: Provides managed Apache Solr search as MCP tools, enabling hybrid retrieval, server-side GPU embeddings, document indexing, and grounded RAG answers without managing infrastructure.

name: openzoo
description: Local x402-paying proxy and MCP server for openzoo.fun, enabling any OpenAI-compatible tool to pay for AI calls using a local burner wallet. It provides tools like zoo_ask for large-corpus questions, model listing, and wallet management.

name: stepik-courses-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server that retrieves educational context from started Stepik courses, offering tools to list courses, explore structure, fetch text step content, and perform local lexical search.

name: exercise-mcp
description: MCP server providing access to 1,324 exercises in 10 languages with animation GIFs, offering tools to list facets, search exercises, get exercise details, and build workouts.

name: wDVC MCP
description: Model Context Protocol server for wDVC that provides tools for architecting DVC pipelines, generating Docker worker commands, searching patterns, and scaffolding wDVC projects.

name: bsv-specmate
description: MCP server that equips AI agents with BSV-specific development tools including static analysis, pitfall prediction, and BSC error diagnosis to produce correct Bluespec code with fewer compile failures.

name: remote-mcp-server-authless
description: Deploy a stateless remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers without authentication, enabling tool calls from MCP clients like Claude Desktop.

name: TrendRadar MCP Server
description: MCP server for TrendRadar that provides AI assistants with access to aggregated real-time news and trending topics from multiple platforms, enabling AI analysis, smart filtering, and customized news delivery.

name: ServiceNow MCP Server
description: Enables users to search and retrieve ServiceNow tickets, knowledge base articles, and service catalog items through the Model Context Protocol.

name: Weather MCP Server
description: Enables real-time weather queries for Chinese and global cities via the wttr.in API, providing current conditions such as temperature, humidity, and wind speed.

name: design-architect-mcp
description: MCP server that exposes a design system and UX rulebook as tools, enabling AI to generate UI consistent with your design tokens, components, layout rules, accessibility guidelines, and templates. It also provides a review tool to score UI proposals against the design system.

name: cubrid-mcp
description: MCP server for exploring CUBRID database schemas and executing read-only SQL queries with policy-based restrictions. Enables safe database interaction through natural language in MCP-compatible clients.

name: codex-bilingual-overlay
description: MCP server for the Codex Bilingual Overlay, enabling control of bilingual translation modes (off, hover, preload) and retrieval of overlay status for the Codex desktop app.

name: Peer Cash MCP
description: Prepare custody-separated Base USDC cash-out plans, list supported fiat rails, and track settlement state through Peer Cash.

name: bench-studio-public
description: MCP server that lets AI agents generate images and videos, build websites, and produce designed PDFs with transparent model routing, cost tracking, and local artifact mirroring.

name: mcp-hsl
description: An MCP server exposing Greater Helsinki public transport data from Digitransit, enabling LLM hosts to answer live transit queries, plan journeys, and fetch stop departures via natural language.

name: WeInc
description: Hosted remote MCP server for WeInc (we.inc), the AI website builder. Manage projects, publishing, custom domains, and previews from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client - nothing to install.

name: aide
description: A unified backend MCP server that aggregates and filters data from external services like Zaim, GitHub, Google, and Notion, providing cross-cutting views via MCP and REST API without heavy AI inference.

name: Testing Agent MCP Server
description: Provides self-healing UI/API test automation via Plan-Generate-Run-Heal cycle, exposing MCP tools for test platforms to trigger batches and retrieve reports.

name: swagger-mcp
description: A stdio MCP server that caches Swagger/OpenAPI documents for multiple backend services and provides offline API search, retrieval, and request example generation. It only contacts remote servers when explicitly refreshing the cache.

name: HR System MCP Server
description: Enables LLM clients to interact with a mock HR system via the Model Context Protocol, supporting queries and workflows across leave, benefits, employee lifecycle, learning, performance, travel, expenses, policies, and FAQs.

name: mcp-explorer
description: A controllable, observable MCP server for dynamically setting tools and intercepting calls in real time, useful as a mock/MITM harness for testing MCP clients.

name: mcp-server
description: A starter MCP server built with the official TypeScript SDK, providing example tools for echoing messages and getting current time.

name: Exchange Mail MCP Server
description: Secure MCP server for Microsoft Exchange. It enables authorized users to list, search, read, download attachments, send, and reply to email via EWS with strict access control and audit.

name: @deitum/testops-mcp
description: MCP server for Allure TestOps that enables searching, reading, and writing test cases, authoring and importing test suites in Markdown, managing launches, and retrieving project statistics, all scoped to a single configured project.

name: dial-pptx-mcp
description: Remote multi-tenant MCP server for generating PowerPoint presentations from corporate templates, preserving theme and branding. Integrates with EPAM AI DIAL file storage and Quick Apps for template input and deck export.
